The '''Pitann droid gladiatorial games''' were a sporting contest held on the planet of [[Pitann]] that began in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The games were initiated by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sho'ban Do]] and [[Uta T'Cha]] as a cover for Do's plan to create a remote control program to take over all the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Kathol Republic]]. The games became a point of contention within the [[Kathol Republic Senatorial Council]].

The games were held in an [[Droid gladiatorial arena|arena]] in the town of [[Ghaz Kul IV]]. Any droid modification was allowed, as long it was only melee weapons. The popularity of the games was massive, and the elite of Pitann, such as senators and mining managers, never missed a contest.
